nodes.body: The row's positional auto-ID also identifies its right-click popup. With date sorting, an incoming message can move another conversation into that position while the menu is open, causing actions such as Pay or Block to target the wrong resident. Use a session-based interaction ID, as `ui/people/rows.rs::allocate` does.
Fixed in b7bedba0.

A name logged before the RLVa `@shownames` restriction became active, or imported from disk, is still exposed by this row, its tooltip and the name filter. `refresh_rlva_privacy` updates the name cache but not these saved entries. Derive privacy-safe display and filter names using `rlva_can_name` and the shared anonymous-name helper, including transcript titles, without changing persisted history metadata.
Fixed in b7bedba0.

`take_save()` clears `dirty` before publication succeeds, but `Worker::send()` can drop a job when its queue is full and `Job::Publish` only logs filesystem failures. Without another change, neither periodic saves nor logout retries the write, so entries can be lost or a confirmed clear can leave the old file intact. Acknowledge successful publication and keep the affected revision dirty until then, retrying enqueue and write failures.
Fixed in 11611299.

If the initial log read is still pending, `take_save(true)` skips the final save and logout then discards entries buffered in `early`. Exit also loses them: its subsequent `flush()` waits for worker jobs but never applies the read result or queues another save. Complete the read-and-merge before discarding the session, or queue the final merge/save on the worker; the exit path in `app.rs:6082–6083` needs the same handling.

Fixed in 11611299. Follow-up 2497a712: clearing the log now drops a read still in flight, so the old file cannot come back, and the toggle-off save is deferred to the next frames instead of blocking the UI (the bounded wait stays at logout and exit).

After an imported row is removed or “Clear conversation log…” is confirmed, the default automatic login import restores the deleted entries because it rereads every Legacy conversation log, including unchanged files. An import already running can also undo a clear. Persist deletion tracking for automatic conversation imports and invalidate pending results when clearing, while allowing an explicit re-import.

Fixed in 328e0409. Follow-up 2497a712: the import state now marks a conversation entry as brought only after the log took it in (or the user removed it on purpose), so a log switched off meanwhile does not lose the entries.

When moving `conversation.log` fails, `relocate()` still returns success and the caller keeps the new folder. If the in-memory log is already saved, nothing republishes it there, so the next login shows no log or the destination's unrelated log. Treat this as a relocation failure and roll back both the transcript moves and any destination-log backup rename.
Fixed in 10a89da8.

The complete log is filtered, uppercased and sorted on every rendered frame, even when unchanged. With friends-first enabled, each comparison also scans the friends list through `Social::is_friend`, giving O(N log N × F) work on the UI thread despite virtualized rows. Cache the order using the log revision, filter/view settings and relevant social changes, and precompute friend membership when rebuilding it.
Fixed in b7bedba0.

Imported entries retain their source `history_file`, although `target_of` renames transcripts—for example, `Club (group) (group).txt` becomes `Club (group).txt`. For a group the user no longer belongs to, the fallback therefore searches for the old filename and both transcript actions fail despite a successful import. Remap each imported entry's history filename through the same source-to-target mapping used for its transcript.
Fixed in 328e0409.

If an outgoing conference is logged before initialization completes, `SessionStarted` replaces its temporary UUID in the live session but leaves the log entry unchanged. The next poll records the server UUID as another conversation, persisting two entries for one conference. Migrate the log entry and `known` key during session remapping, including entries buffered while the file is being read.
Fixed in 15fa7827; the display name rule is also covered by a unit test now (2497a712).

Automatic login imports still add and save conversation entries when “Keep a conversation log” is off: `import_found()` is gated by `log_im`, and `Log::imported()` marks the list dirty without checking whether logging is enabled. With the default import-at-login setting, disabling the log therefore does not prevent new contact records from being persisted. Skip the conversation portion of automatic imports when `log_conversations` is false, while retaining transcript imports.
Fixed in 328e0409.
